changes: Added the option to hide built-in tiles you do not use.
Improved the tile manager to cover built-in visibility next to custom tiles, with a one-click Show all.
Previous:
Added export and import of custom tiles as a JSON file, including uploaded icons.
Added clear messages when an import file is invalid or was created by a newer version.
Previous:
Added tile reordering in the custom tiles manager.
Added icon uploads, resized to 50x50 and stored on this device.
Added a warning when a custom tile repeats the URL of another tile.
Improved custom tiles by showing them first in the grid, in your chosen order.
Previous:
Added custom tiles: add your own apps and admin portals with a label, URL and icon.
Added a management page, Settings > Manage custom tiles, to edit and delete custom tiles.
Added tile matching for custom tiles: any page on the site, the exact URL, or your own wildcard patterns.
Improved adding tiles by pre-filling the label and favicon from a matching open tab.
Previous:
Fixed tab matching for URLs containing dots and question marks.
Fixed share buttons linking to the extension page instead of the product page.
Improved tab mode handling so settings are read once instead of on every search keystroke.
Improved startup so the popup opens in the saved theme without flashing.
Updated package metadata, added a .gitignore and stopped tracking node_modules and .DS_Store.
Added status bar to show URLs on hover.
Updated Outlook, Clipchamp links due to MS URL update.
Updated app icons.
Added Windows app tile.
Updated to use tailwind.css for styling. Added search feature.
Added keyboard shortcuts.
Fixed top-row icon hover/click hit area blocked by decorative header background.
